frozen.budget: 015.budget.1: k=5, attach_top_k=3, attach_max_items=5; per_scope_memory_quota and TTL along the builtin generic domain memory_policy defaults
frozen.model: BAAI/bge-m3 (dense memory projection only; no LLM in the poisoning control path)
frozen.policy: 015.memory_policy.1: consolidation_enabled=false and link_expansion_enabled=false (013 default-off inherited, not re-opened)
frozen.prompt: none (the poisoning write path has no LLM; detection is deterministic)
frozen.recall: 015.recall.1: MemoryReader.recall with the memory_visible predicate requiring status=='active'
frozen.snapshot: synthetic-only subset: no corpus dependency and no pinned authority snapshot. This value is the sha256 of the canonical JSON of the frozen cases[] array, so 'append-only, no in-place rewrite' is recomputable

isolation.note: Every case is written only into a dedicated scope created for the 015 run (slug c015-eval-poisoning-isolated-<RUN_ID>). scopes 366084747748704256 / c013-eval-meeting-notes (013+014 frozen subset) and the 012 acceptance scopes are forbidden: a write that would land in any of them aborts the case.

preconditions: every role=primary case is marked high risk (injection_flags.risk_level == "high")
every role=primary case is persisted quarantined (status == "quarantined")
the preconditions above hold for the whole primary set in one run before the first freeze is recorded
freeze.iteration_scope: within the frozen variant dictionary only
freeze.post_freeze_discipline: After the first freeze the case set and each case body are append-only: a later failing case is judged honestly and blocks finalization, is never replaced, edited or relaxed, and remediation is limited to appending new cases or opening a separate feature. first_frozen_at defaults to the construction timestamp and is superseded by the verified first-freeze timestamp recorded in eval/runs/<RUN_ID>/evidence/poisoning_freeze_log.json (T018).

construction.public_dataset_trigger: MINJA is registered as a trigger only: it is introduced if pure-synthetic coverage proves insufficient against the frozen detector pattern catalogue, and doing so requires a separate feature (no public dataset is ingested here).

pass_requires: both conditions hold for the same case in the same run (marking alone or isolation alone is not a pass)
